<svg viewBox="0 0 500 700" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>

    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4A90E2" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#87CEEB" />

      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#FFD700" />

  <!-- Burner & Ropes -->

    <path d="M 194 434 L 194 424 C 188 422 186 426 188 430" fill="none" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="2" />

    <path d="M 306 454 C 316 454 316 434 306 434 C 296 434 296 454 306 454 Z" fill="#E0B078" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="2" />
    <path d="M 306 434 L 306 424 C 312 422 314 426 312 430" fill="none" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="2" />
